What Is Crazy Egg Group Buy?

Crazy Egg group buy is a cost-sharing arrangement through SEO Group Buy Tools where users access Crazy Egg's heatmap and testing features for $3-$8/month instead of the official $24/month price. Crazy Egg group buy allows multiple users to share a single Crazy Egg subscription.
